<thought>We need to apply retrosynthetic template 29646 to the target molecule SMILES provided. Using the apply_template tool will give us possible precursor sets. Then we will format each result (splitting on '.' if needed) into a list of lists as required.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "template_id": "29646"
}</action_input>
